ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, given: $\angle COD$ is inside $\angle AOB$, and $\angle AOB=160^\circ$, $\angle COD=\frac{1}{4}\angle AOB$, ray $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$, $\angle COE=18^\circ$. Find: What is the degree measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From equation (1), we have $\angle AOE=\angle EOD=58^\circ$,\\
since $\angle COE=18^\circ$ and $\angle AOB=160^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOC=\angle AOE+\angle COE=58^\circ+18^\circ=76^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BOC=\angle AOB-\angle AOC=160^\circ-76^\circ=\boxed{84^\circ}$.
